title: 得州线上学校扩张 公共资金流向教育企业
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Online education in the United States has just boomed in recent years.
segments.zh: 近年来，美国在线教育蓬勃发展。

segments.en: While virtual classrooms were abandoned for the real thing during pandemic lockdowns, now the promise of flexibility and self-paced learning has wooed many parents to go all in.
segments.zh: 疫情期间，虚拟课堂一度被实体课堂取代，但如今灵活性和自定进度学习的承诺吸引了许多家长全力投入。

segments.en: K-12 powered schools are tuition-free in the comfort of your own home.
segments.zh: K-12在线学校免学费，让你在家舒适学习。

segments.en: Texas families, this is big news. This is full-time school just done in a completely online environment.
segments.zh: 德克萨斯州的家庭，这是重大消息。这是完全在线环境下的全日制学校。

segments.en: As of the most recent data that we have available, about one in every 80 public school children attend a fully online school.
segments.zh: 根据最新数据，大约每80名公立学校学生中就有一名就读于完全在线学校。

segments.en: And nowhere in the U.S. has this expansion happened faster than in Texas.
segments.zh: 在美国，这种扩张在德克萨斯州最为迅速。

segments.en: If you are a Texas resident and you have considered virtual school, good news.
segments.zh: 如果你是德克萨斯州居民并考虑过虚拟学校，好消息来了。

segments.en: In Texas, virtual school enrollment has more than doubled since 2020.
segments.zh: 在德克萨斯州，自2020年以来，虚拟学校入学人数增加了一倍多。

segments.en: Texas offers many virtual school options, and 56% of students enrolled in them, attend a school operated by a publicly traded company called Stride.
segments.zh: 德克萨斯州提供许多虚拟学校选择，其中56%的入学学生就读于一家名为Stride的上市公司运营的学校。

segments.en: With millions in taxpayer funds flowing into these private companies, the question is who's benefiting the most, the students, or the business.
segments.zh: 随着数百万纳税人的资金流入这些私营公司，问题是誰受益最大，是学生还是企业。

segments.en: The biggest school in Texas is 25,000 students,
segments.zh: 得克萨斯州最大的学校有2.5万名学生，

segments.en: and almost all of them will never step foot in the actual school district.
segments.zh: 而他们几乎都不会踏入实际的学区校园。

segments.en: That school is Texas Virtual Academy, located in Hallsville Independent School District.
segments.zh: 这所学校是位于霍尔斯维尔独立学区的得克萨斯虚拟学院。
